description: Search 4,000+ dissected top-performing videos (launch films, product demos, explainers, motion design, interactive/3D, film + music, teasers, UGC ads). Free: works with no key and no sign-in. Without an account it returns short cards (REF id, title, maker, length, aspect, still, link, one-line summary), up to 8 at a time and 30 searches an hour. Signed in to Refs, it returns full cards: also views, measured metrics (shots, cuts per minute, voice, music) and why each works. UGC ads (category ugc) are creator-style ads that won on Meta or TikTok or went viral; their metrics add the signal: source, ugc_format, industry, days_running, variants, reach, ctr_pct, budget_level, advertiser and why_it_won. Use it to find references before making a video; pass a ref to get_blueprint or plan_video (those need a Refs account with Pro; the app asks the user to sign in).

ai_made.description: true = made with AI/code (Claude, Remotion, three.js); false = human-made

aspect.description: Frame shape, as cards name it: 16:9 (landscape), 9:16 (vertical/reels), 1:1 (square), 4:5 (portrait feed)

brand.description: A tracked brand, e.g. linear, higgsfield, runway, vercel, openai

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

made_with.description: Tool, e.g. claude, remotion, three.js, manim, after effects

min_days_running.description: UGC ads: Meta ads that ran at least this many days (30 = a winner, 60 = strong)

platform.description: UGC ads: where the winning signal comes from (meta = ran on Meta, tiktok = TikTok's top ads, organic = went viral unpaid)

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'developer tool launch dark UI', 'founder to camera', 'kinetic type', 'terminal UI launch'. Films matching every word come first; if none does, films matching some of the words (the result then has a note). A REF id or a YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram Reel or Meta Ad Library link finds that film.

sort.description: recommended = only the films a digital product (SaaS, app, AI or dev tool) would copy for its launch film, best first; none = every film, with those recommended ones still first; signal = UGC ads with the strongest winning signal first (days running, CTR percentile, views)

tag.description: A curated collection: app-store-header: short loops apps use as the App Store product-page header video (iOS 27); saas: launch and demo films from B2B SaaS companies; developer-tools: launch films and demos from developer tools (editors, terminals, APIs); fintech: films from payments, banking and finance products; crypto: launch films from crypto and web3 products; hardware: launch films for physical hardware products; automotive: car and vehicle launch films; robotics: robot and autonomous-machine films; kinetic-type: films led by kinetic typography (moving type); ui-animation: films of animated product UI and transitions; 3d-animation: films made with 3D animation and renders; product-reveal: films built around a product reveal; logo-reveal: logo reveal pieces; data-visualization: films that animate charts, maps and data; before-after: before-and-after films (problem, then result)
